TOOLING BURST T1b — intent gates + dope sheets + pose guides + G6c (SPEC § 6 row "T1b"). task_id "T1b".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 6 rows T1a-idle, T1a-idle-2, T1a-walk-3, T1b (T1b is your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. astra_test_01/burst/oracle/*.py, oracle/bands_idle.json, oracle/bands_walk.json, gates/{common.py, matte.py, g6_seam.py, drift48.py, README.md}, tests/{test_oracle_idle.py, test_oracle_walk.py, test_gates_g6_seam.py, gates_helpers.py}.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

BUILD exactly the SPEC row: gates/idle_intent.py, gates/gait_intent.py, oracle/dope_sheet.py, oracle/pose_guide.py, the G6c function in gates/g6_seam.py (additive; existing G6/G6b untouched), and the tests listed. Then RUN and report numbers in the receipt concerns:
  (a) idle_intent on /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K3-reg-02/frames/idle/S against bands_idle.json row 'combat' (uncommitted → passed null; report value vs floor for breath and head bob, and the region LOCK/MOTION classification by displacement).
  (b) dope_sheet.idle_sheet(row 'combat', n_frames=8, fps=12) and idle_sheet(row 'combat', n_frames=16, fps=8) → write runs/C-1/oracle/dope_idle_combat_8.json/.txt and _16.json/.txt (the .txt is the prompt_text).
  (c) dope_sheet.walk_sheet(row 'plate13_lateral_ann' if present else the best available walk row, n_frames=12) → runs/C-1/oracle/dope_walk_12.json/.txt; pose_guide.render_walk_guide(…, H_px=400) → runs/C-1/oracle/pose_guides/walk_{00..11}.png.
  (d) G6c on the K3 walk frames if a registered walk set exists under runs/C-1/artifacts/K3-reg-01/frames/walk (else skip and say so).
Then run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected all green except the four named T0-d3 reds (and any T1a-walk reds that the T1a-walk-3 receipt left standing — name them, do not touch them); report exact counts.

DO NOT touch: lane/, oracles/, parts/, transcribe/, compare/, bible/, the oracle T1a modules (read only), other gates, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, briefs/, fixtures/. Under runs/ write ONLY runs/C-1/oracle/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T1b"): files with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns with numbers for (a)–(d) and the suite counts. Never PASS/FAIL.
